name: Fitchburg State Forest
state_or_region: Massachusetts (Fitchburg, Lunenburg & Townsend — with Pearl Hill State Park & Willard Brook)
summary: Rolling hemlock and pine woods, brooks and ponds north of Fitchburg: Pearl Hill, Table Rock, Trap Falls and a dense web of shared hiking and mountain-bike trails.
